description: This file contains PHP classes that compile Smarty template tags {for}, {forelse}, and {/for} for the Smarty templating engine. It defines classes for compiling loop constructs in Smarty templates, including handling different syntax variations and nested loops.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_For
classes.description: Class for compiling {for} tags, supporting different loop syntaxes and generating PHP code for loops.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Forelse
classes.description: Class for compiling {forelse} tags, handling the else part of loops.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Forclose
classes.description: Class for compiling {/for} tags, closing loops and managing nested loop state.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Main method in each class that generates PHP code for the respective Smarty tag.
